11901|c5ceacbe.name: Andruk
11901|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

12196|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Kaylisk
12196|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

12616|c5ceacbe.name: Vhulgra
12616|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

12696|f1d5ba87.name: Senani Thunderheart
12696|f1d5ba87.text: Do you hear the call of the hunt, $c?  You must listen closely, but the call comes from deep within you.  It comes from deep within all of us.

12724|39b67c2e.name: Pixel
12724|39b67c2e.text: This forest can be confusing! Be careful out there.

12736|e3f9a765.name: Je'neu Sancrea
12736|e3f9a765.text: The elements speak to us, $c.  They share knowledge that we must learn, and they share secrets that must be kept.

12737|aa838c4f.name: Mastok Wrilehiss
12737|aa838c4f.text:
If you want to know about the comings and goings of caravans and merchants here in Splintertree Post, then I am fortunately the orc you are looking for.  Unfortunately for you though, I don't like people.

If you want something, make it quick.

12757|9b4e17a6.name: Karang Amakkar
12757|9b4e17a6.text: Greeting $c - welcome to the front lines in our conquest of Ashenvale!  If you are looking for something to do, then you've come to the right place.  I'm always looking for able-bodied individuals to help bring glory to the Horde!

13085|412e073b.name: Myrokos Silentform
13085|412e073b.text:
We are all pieces of a much larger puzzle, $N. Just as you guide the piece of a puzzle to its destination, so too are we guided by another.

And perhaps they who guide us are themselves guided by an even greater force.

1938|cd4928e4.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
1938|cd4928e4.text: The Kirin Tor did not heed my warnings! The Alliance is a sham. Arugal is a reckless fool.

2121|bf7b697c.name: Shadow Priest Allister
2121|bf7b697c.text: Information... With our scouts and agents, we control the flow of information in Lordaeron. Scourge movements, their holdings, all underneath our watchful eyes...

2215|dc484bb4.name: High Executor Darthalia
2215|dc484bb4.text: In order to serve the Dark Lady and Varimathras we need to advance the front on the Human Infestation.

2216|8e0e34da.name: Apothecary Lydon
2216|8e0e34da.text: We are but so close to developing the New Plague that our Dark Lady desires with such fervor.

2226|dd7de3ae.name: Karos Razok
2226|dd7de3ae.text: Greetings.  Our bats are well trained and fed.  You'll not find faster.

2238|5408b909.name: Tog'thar
2238|5408b909.text: Marlgen... One of the jailors. He has the key to my bonds.

2238|6d472bad.name: Tog'thar
2238|6d472bad.text: Get away from here, $c, or they'll put you in chains as well.

2239|4513b5ec.name: Drull
2239|4513b5ec.text: Do you mock me while I am unable to defend myself, bound to this ball of iron?

2239|7c058ec5.name: Drull
2239|7c058ec5.text: One of the humans has the key to this infernal contraption. Eston I think they said his name was.

223|43871080.name: Dan Golthas
223|43871080.text: I can't help you; your work is beyond my own. Talk to Arthur Moore, over there by the coffins. He'll be able to train you further.

2388|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Shay
2388|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

2389|c5ceacbe.name: Zarise
2389|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2391|5dffcf15.name: Serge Hinott
2391|5dffcf15.text: Another interruption. How am I supposed to get any work done like this? Don't answer that; do I look as if I care what you have to say? Why don't you go bother Mr. High-And-Mighty instead?

2393|e26243eb.name: Christoph Jeffcoat
2393|e26243eb.text: Can I show you what I have for sale?

248196|dd3ed090.name: Apothecary Durelle
248196|dd3ed090.text:
Please do not touch the vials unless you intend to purchase one.

Fingerprints ruin the value, you see.

248201|5de3438e.name: Pawani
248201|5de3438e.text: Greetings, friend! I have an ample supply of leather and hides, and I know a few techniques I might be willing to share. Interested in doing business?

256388|13e9970d.name: Jornah
256388|13e9970d.text:
Greetings and well met, $N! Your arrival is timely, and we here at the Durotar Supply and Logistics company are always in need of new contractors.

If you are someone with a knack for gathering useful materials or the skills to craft something from scratch, you have a place here.

Please let me know if you have any questions.

2851|c5ceacbe.name: Urda
2851|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2934|2cd97b51.name: Keeper Bel'dugur
2934|2cd97b51.text: Knowledge is both tool and weapon to those with the will to use it.

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3328|0402cd55.name: Ormok
3328|0402cd55.text: The Shattered Hand will see the Horde to their former glory, unhindered by the timidness of the Warchief.

3328|08830bac.name: Ormok
3328|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

3328|88dc2d97.name: Ormok
3328|88dc2d97.text: Messengers from Ravenholdt delivered this letter to me this morning. It is addressed to you, $N.

3557|a43ce262.name: Guillaume Sorouy
3557|a43ce262.text: Your interruption is costing me valuable time, this had better be good.

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

4582|08830bac.name: Carolyn Ward
4582|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

4582|0deb5cc3.name: Carolyn Ward
4582|0deb5cc3.text: With the sanction of Lord Varimathras, the Deathstalkers' numbers grow. More blades to strike at our enemies when they least expect it.

4582|6634d541.name: Carolyn Ward
4582|6634d541.text: The Syndicate keeps many locked boxes of supplies in Durnholde Keep in Hillsbrad.

4582|b0da17d0.name: Carolyn Ward
4582|b0da17d0.text: I got something for you, $N. Looks important.

4588|8c2f02e7.name: Arthur Moore
4588|8c2f02e7.text: I'm pleased to say that your talents have outpaced my own. Go away now. Err, try the tauren Una in the northwestern shops of Thunder Bluff's central plateau. She's very skilled, I assure you.

4591|a28d29e1.name: Mary Edras
4591|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

6707|ad3fc7ec.name: Fahrad
6707|ad3fc7ec.text: Come to learn from the master eh?

6739|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Bates
6739|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

6766|99fe5cf8.name: Ravenholdt Guard
6766|99fe5cf8.text: Ravenholdt Manor does not recognize you, $c.

6766|fe3fc309.name: Ravenholdt Guard
6766|fe3fc309.text: Brash. Master Ravenholdt does not like brash.

9087|e4fd33dd.name: Bashana Runetotem
9087|e4fd33dd.text: Greetings, noble $c.  This humble servant of the Cenarion Circle wishes blessings and bounties be given unto you and yours.

9564|8d6952f8.name: Frezza
9564|8d6952f8.text: Of course there's no danger in everything catching flames and exploding like a huge helium bomb. This baby will get you to Undercity faster and safer than any boat, and the view is truly breathtaking. Speaking of breath, smoking is not allowed while on board the zeppelin, and fire spells are banned from being cast during the trip.

9566|fc033aae.name: Zapetta
9566|fc033aae.text: My brother said we could make great money with this trade route, but he didn't tell me I would be the one living on this side. If you come back this way on the Zeppelin, could you bring me something to eat? They sell some of the finest meat in Orgrimmar, and I sure could use something that didn't die weeks before it stopped moving.

1013-complete.name: Keeper Bel'dugur
1013-complete.text:
Very good.  This book will add nicely to my collections of the workings of Ur.  His knowledge was great, but his conscience held him from true power.  And so when the Scourge came and his strength was tested, it failed.

We of the Forsaken cannot afford such weakness, if we are to survive...

...If we are to conquer.
1013-complete.title: The Book of Ur

1014-complete.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
1014-complete.text: Silverpine Forest is finally free from the vice of that wretch Arugal. You have done the Dark Lady a great service, $N. Your tenacity shall be rewarded.
1014-complete.title: Arugal Must Die

1014-progress.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
1014-progress.text: With Arugal's death we stand to increase the Dark Lady's stronghold on Lordaeron.
1014-progress.title: Arugal Must Die

1098-complete.name: Unknown
1098-complete.text:
Vincent's body lies broken, and still.

Although Deathstalker Adamant will send his report to Hadrec... whatever additional details Vincent gained must remain with him.

But clutched in his hand is a small trinket...
1098-complete.title: Deathstalkers in Shadowfang

1164-accept.name: Genavie Callow
1164-accept.text:
The harlot! The swine! Kenata still lives; her family healthy and prospering while I suffer. Forsaken indeed!

My family is gone, taken by the plague. Our estate also forfeit; looted and burned during the war. And after all that, her and her lousy children had the audacity to steal the only precious belongings I had left.

I don't care about the things they stole any more. What I want now are their heads!

Kill them for me! Go to the Dabyrie Farmstead in Arathi, northeast of Refuge Point.
1164-accept.title: To Steal From Thieves

2-accept.name: Unknown
2-accept.text: The mighty hippogryph Sharptalon has been slain, with the claw of the felled beast serving as a testament to your victory.  Senani Thunderheart at the Splintertree Post will no doubt be interested in seeing this trophy as proof of your deeds.
2-accept.title: Sharptalon's Claw

2-complete.name: Senani Thunderheart
2-complete.text:
Most impressive, $N... the claw of Sharptalon could not have been easy to get!  The Ashenvale Hunt goes well for you!

Sharptalon had long terrorized the peons from the lumber camps near its path as they tried to travel here to Splintertree Post.  No doubt once the word gets out that it was you who put down the beast, many rousing songs of your bravery will be heard at campfires and lumber mills across Ashenvale!
2-complete.title: Sharptalon's Claw

2-progress.name: Senani Thunderheart
2-progress.text: Yes, mighty $c, I sensed your arrival.  I trust you have more news to report to me about your hunt?
2-progress.title: Sharptalon's Claw

216-accept.name: Karang Amakkar
216-accept.text:
The Thistlefur furbolgs are threatening our expansion!  Thistlefur Village to our east blocks the way between us here and the Splintertree Post.  It's a path that would circumvent the village of Astranaar; without it, we give the Alliance an extra expansion path.

$N, we must not allow... an expansion path gap!

Proceed to Thistlefur Village and thin out the furbolgs.  You will be given compensation for this task, but more importantly you will be doing your duty for the Horde!
216-accept.title: Between a Rock and a Thistlefur

216-complete.name: Karang Amakkar
216-complete.text:
Well done $c, well done!  I will continue to send forces to thin out the furbolg, but I can at least count on a different path that will be free of Alliance entanglements.  The Horde conquest of Ashenvale is now in full swing!

You've earned your pay this day, hero.  I salute you!
216-complete.title: Between a Rock and a Thistlefur

25-accept.name: Mastok Wrilehiss
25-accept.text:
If you want to be useful, then why don't you do something about the situation near Talondeep Path?

The transports between Ashenvale and Stonetalon are at a standstill because of the lake coming alive and attacking anything that gets close... which means anyone on the path.  What'd be even more useful than just putting the hammer down on the water elementals there is someone scouting the gazebo on Mystral Lake - the one that has a solid view of the Alliance outpost there.

You up for being useful?
25-accept.title: Stonetalon Standstill

25-complete.name: Mastok Wrilehiss
25-complete.text:
Yeah, I heard that someone tore up the lake out there like a dust devil through the Barrens.  From the sound of it too, we might be able to set up a possible observation area out there to keep an eye on our Alliance friends.  Well, that is if we can keep it on the down low...

Looks like you ended up being quite useful after all; the transports between here and Stonetalon should have an easier time of it.  Take this - you've earned it.
25-complete.title: Stonetalon Standstill

442-complete.name: High Executor Hadrec
442-complete.text:
The death of Thule Ravenclaw was no small event, $N.  Renferrel tells me that the energies released when you destroyed Thule were felt even as far as the Sepulcher.

Your actions ring through the ranks of the Forsaken.  Your value to us grows.
442-complete.title: Assault on Fenris Isle

451-complete.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
451-complete.text:
Such a blow to the Royal Apothecary Society to lose Berard.  But through your hard work and Apothecary Renferrel's diligent research Berard's studies will still be useful to The Dark Lady's plight.

We are on the cusp of something great here, $N.  If you were not so skilled in the ways of combat I would try to recruit you for membership in the Society.
451-complete.title: A Recipe For Death

451-progress.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
451-progress.text: What brings you back to the Undercity, $N?
451-progress.title: A Recipe For Death

480-accept.name: Shadow Priest Allister
480-accept.text:
An archmage of great power is overseeing the reactivation of the ley energy node. With the progress they have made, our only hope of stopping them is by killing him. It will be difficult, he is no doubt protected by many other mages and warders.

You must go, and you must dispatch him quickly. When he is dead, retrieve his staff for me. Go now.
480-accept.title: The Weaver

491-complete.name: Bethor Iceshard
491-complete.text:
...what is this?  Thule had our Woven Wand?  I thought it was lost when our friendship sundered and he sided with the Lich King!

He must not have invoked its power, for if he had I would have sensed it.  And it is good that he did not use it...

This is a marvelous find.  You have my gratitude, $N, and will be rewarded.
491-complete.title: Wand to Bethor

493-complete.name: Apothecary Lydon
493-complete.text: Ah, most excellent.  Apothecary Renferrel has my utmost respect.  I am anxious to study his work.
493-complete.title: Journey to Hillsbrad Foothills

494-complete.name: High Executor Darthalia
494-complete.text:
The raven's cry from the west doth beckon?

Superb news!  Hillsbrad is ripe for attack.  We can carry out our plan of destruction now.  Varimathras will be pleased.
494-complete.title: Time To Strike

496-accept.name: Apothecary Lydon
496-accept.text:
Ah, another wretched day in Tarren Mill.  All of this clean air puts me in such a foul mood, $N.

The sooner we can plague the humans here, the better.  I've been conducting intense studies on possible killing agents to use in my concoctions but I haven't the time to collect them all.

If you want to make yourself of use, procure the following items for me:  10 Gray Bear Tongues and the very rare and hard to find, Creeper Ichor.  You'll find both bears and creepers just outside of Tarren Mill.
496-accept.title: Elixir of Suffering

496-complete.name: Apothecary Lydon
496-complete.text: These specimens are perfect.  Well, $N, you have managed to bring me the slightest hint of joy on yet another miserable day.  Your efforts are appreciated.
496-complete.title: Elixir of Suffering

496-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
496-progress.text: I see you are back.  I hope you were able to gather the agents I need.  Another deathless day will put me in such a gloomy mood.
496-progress.title: Elixir of Suffering

498-accept.name: Krusk
498-accept.text:
Me and some other warriors were sent by the Warchief to retrieve an object from Durnholde and to investigate this so-called Syndicate.

We went to Durnholde to take a look around, but we were taken by surprise by a large number of the humans. We fought bravely, but their sheer numbers were enough to defeat us. They took a few of us captive, but I was able to escape.

Durnholde is just southeast of here, across the river. Drull and Tog'thar are being held there, you must go and rescue them.
498-accept.title: The Rescue

498-complete.name: Krusk
498-complete.text:
So the humans thought to turn our warriors into slaves, did they? We'll show them!

It would seem that they have taken Gol'dir, our leader, to another location. We must find him and rescue him. But we currently have no clue where he is...

When we have a lead, I will be sure to tell you, $N.
498-complete.title: The Rescue

499-accept.name: Apothecary Lydon
499-accept.text:
It will take but a moment for me to mix these components into what I have deemed an Elixir of Suffering.

There we go!  Ah, nothing brightens a gloomy day in these miserable foothills like bringing a little suffering into the world.

Let us see if our little potion has achieved its desired effect.

Give my assistant Umpi a taste of what the Dark Lady has planned for both humans and Scourge alike.
499-accept.title: Elixir of Suffering

501-accept.name: Apothecary Lydon
501-accept.text:
Oh, $N. . .the flowers are blooming in Hillsbrad and the air is so fresh and brisk.  I can't help but to wallow in the misery of it all.  I look out my grimy window and long for the day when our New Plague brings this world the death it deserves.

As much as I would love to sit and brood all day, my duty to the Dark Lady calls.  Help me, would you?  My research leads me to believe I can make the most splendid death-brew with the blood of a Mountain Lion.  Bring some to me and we'll have a little fun.
501-accept.title: Elixir of Pain

501-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
501-progress.text: I remember you, $N.  You were going to help me out in concocting my latest elixir.  I'll need that blood before I can bring my own special brand of misery to the inhabitants of Hillsbrad.
501-progress.title: Elixir of Pain

502-accept.name: Apothecary Lydon
502-accept.text:
Ah, nothing like the smell of fresh blood in the foothills!

Now we'll mix in a touch of this and a little of that and let the real fun begin!  What I have created with this blood, I like to call an Elixir of Pain.  If my calculations are correct this concoction could be the start of something very beautiful for Lady Sylvanas.  But what we need is a test.

Take this elixir out to the northern farm in Hillsbrad Fields to the southwest.  Let's see how Farmer Ray's little dog Stanley likes this "treat."
502-accept.title: Elixir of Pain

502-complete.name: Stanley
502-complete.text: You pour some of the elixir into your hand and hold it before Stanley's mouth.
502-complete.title: Elixir of Pain

509-accept.name: Apothecary Lydon
509-accept.text:
Another day, another elixir to be made. If it were up to me, I'd just let the pathetic humans and Scourge fight it out.  They seem bent on killing each other as is.

Alas, our Dark Lady wants to help speed up the process a tad so why not pass these morbid days by spreading a little death and disease across the land?

Here's the plan, $N: you go out to Nethander Stead, south of Tarren Mill and east of the river and Southshore. Collect for me 6 Mudsnout Blossoms from the field for my next elixir.
509-accept.title: Elixir of Agony

516-complete.name: Shadow Priest Allister
516-complete.text: If our scouts and agents continue to procure valuable information such as this, we shall have the Lich King's Scourge removed from our lands in no time.
516-complete.title: Beren's Peril

527-accept.name: High Executor Darthalia
527-accept.text:
Stand at attention while addressing me, $c.

I am under direct command of Varimathras.  We are to quell the human infestation until our apothecaries can develop the new plague.

Our information leads us to believe that the town of Hillsbrad is vulnerable to attack.  Your first assignment is aimed at disrupting their food supply and infrastructure.

Travel west.  Raid the northernmost farms of Hillsbrad Fields.  Make sure that the landowners, Farmer Ray and Farmer Getz, are executed as well.
527-accept.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

527-complete.name: High Executor Darthalia
527-complete.text: At ease, $c.  I see you have returned from battle.  My sources tell me you performed well on the Hillsbrad front.
527-complete.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

528-accept.name: High Executor Darthalia
528-accept.text:
Word of the attack on the northern farms has the townsfolk panicked.  Most excellent.

Our Deathstalkers report peasants fleeing to the fields in southern Hillsbrad.  The fools think they can hide in the orchards and escape their doom.

Prove them wrong, $N.  Return to Hillsbrad Fields and seek out the cowering peasants.  Lay waste to them in the name of our Dark Lady.

Dismissed!
528-accept.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

528-complete.name: High Executor Darthalia
528-complete.text: The grip of death is tightening around the town of Hillsbrad.  The battle goes well.
528-complete.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

529-accept.name: High Executor Darthalia
529-accept.text:
The humans of Hillsbrad have been putting up unexpected resistance.  The problem appears to be that the townsfolk are being armed by the local blacksmith.  We need to shut down all supply lines.

Your mission will be to execute Blacksmith Verringtan.  Slay his apprentices as well.  While there, bring back a shipment of iron from their stockpile.  The supplies will come in handy when we are done with the conquering of Hillsbrad and begin razing Southshore.
529-accept.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

529-complete.name: High Executor Darthalia
529-complete.text: Mission accomplished, $c.  And carried out quite skillfully, I might add.
529-complete.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

529-progress.name: High Executor Darthalia
529-progress.text: Were you able to carry out your orders, $c?  Did you dispose of Verringtan and his assistants?  And where is that iron shipment?
529-progress.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

530-complete.name: Raleigh Andrean
530-complete.text:
Ah, good.  These hands killed my wife, Deliah.  Revenge for her murder was my only care, and you were the instrument of that revenge.

Here, take the ring you returned earlier.  Deliah has been dead to me for so long, her ring is a bauble I no longer care to keep.  Instead, I will keep these hands as a remembrance of my friend's betrayal.
530-complete.title: A Husband's Revenge

532-accept.name: High Executor Darthalia
532-accept.text:
The town of Hillsbrad is in disarray and we believe it will soon fall.  We must, however, persist in our ruthlessness until the human scum are wiped from the foothills for eternity.

Despite their overwhelming losses, the humans rally around their leadership and keep fighting.  We must eliminate their leader, Magistrate Burnside, as well as the town council.  Destroy their revered political document as well, the Hillsbrad Proclamation.  And while you're at it, steal the town registry.
532-accept.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

532-complete.name: High Executor Darthalia
532-complete.text: News of your glories in Hillsbrad traveled fast.  You have done well, $c.
532-complete.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

539-accept.name: High Executor Darthalia
539-accept.text:
The Hillsbrad Town Registry indicates that the Azureload Mine is under Alliance control.  Furthermore, the mine is a prime source of iron ore for the Alliance armories.

Even though we've struck a decisive blow to the town of Hillsbrad, the Alliance still supports and protects the Azureload Mine fervently.

The mine lies due south of Hillsbrad.  Go there and slay the foreman, a human by the name of Bonds.  Kill his miners as well.  That should send a clear message to the Alliance.
539-accept.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

539-complete.name: High Executor Darthalia
539-complete.text: The Dark Lady will be pleased when she learns that she has a new mine from which she can arm her soldiers.
539-complete.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

541-accept.name: High Executor Darthalia
541-accept.text:
Dwarves aiding the humans?  Damn those filthy little beasts.

We shall test the strength of the so-called Alliance.  We'll see how anxious those little ankle-bashers are to help the humans once they feel our wrath.  We know exactly where their stronghold is in this territory.

They have established a barracks in southeastern Hillsbrad along Thoradin's Wall called Dun Garok.  The final mission of this battle is to lay siege on Dun Garok, $c.  Captain Ironhill, their leader, must die.
541-accept.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

546-accept.name: Deathguard Samsa
546-accept.text:
I hear you were enlisted by Darthalia to wage war on the humans of Hillsbrad.  So jealous I am. . .

While you're off having all the fun -- slaying humans, pillaging the town, terrorizing innocent people -- I am stuck standing guard here in Tarren Mill.

Perhaps you'll take pity on an old Deathguard like myself?  You see I am collecting human skulls.  And you will be fighting humans for quite some time.  Over the course of your long battle, bring me 30 skulls and I will make it worth your while.
546-accept.title: Souvenirs of Death

547-accept.name: Deathguard Humbert
547-accept.text:
High Executor Darthalia sent me to keep watch of Dun Garok from a distance.  I had set up camp just out of sight.  But when morning came and I had to boil water, I left to gather firewood.

When I returned to camp, I discovered my gear was missing.

Apparently some dwarven scouts from Dun Garok had passed by and made off with it.  I need my sword!  If you can get it back for me I would be so grateful.  So many dwarves there...it will be quite difficult to find the dirty little thief who stole it.
547-accept.title: Humbert's Sword

549-accept.name: Unknown
549-accept.text:
By the authority of Lady Sylvanas, all members of the organization known as the Syndicate are wanted dead. Those brought into custody or taken prisoner will be summarily executed. They are currently known to be amassing in the ruins of Durnholde Keep, to the southeast of Tarren Mill.

A handsome reward is offered to all who bring proof of their deeds to High Executor Darthalia.
549-accept.title: WANTED: Syndicate Personnel

549-complete.name: High Executor Darthalia
549-complete.text: Excellent, $c. At this rate, the Syndicate pest will be rid from the land in no time.
549-complete.title: WANTED: Syndicate Personnel

567-accept.name: Unknown
567-accept.text:
Dangerous!

The following humans of Hillsbrad have been deemed dangerous and are marked for bounty by High Executor Darthalia:

Clerk Horrace Whitesteed.  Wanted for the murder of Deathguard Toma.

Citizen Wilkes.  Wanted for the murder of Apothecary Eli.

Miner Hackett.  Wanted for the murder of Deathstalker Fry.

Farmer Kalaba.  Wanted for the ambush of supplies from the Undercity.

All of these enemies are hiding and will be hard to find.  A reward will be granted upon notice of their death.
567-accept.title: Dangerous!

567-complete.name: High Executor Darthalia
567-complete.text: You are quite the bounty hunter, $c.  Well done.
567-complete.title: Dangerous!

6441-accept.name: Pixel
6441-accept.text:
Heya! I've been traveling through Ashenvale, heading towards Ratchet, and decided to make a stop here at Splintertree. I'm always looking for an opportunity, and it seems that satyr horns are in high demand in Ratchet these days.

After asking around here, it seems that the satyrs in Night Run, Satyrnaar, and Xavian all have the type of horns I am looking for. I'm no match for those satyrs... but you look like you might be!

Tell you what, you collect the horns for me and I'll make it worth your time.
6441-accept.title: Satyr Horns

6441-complete.name: Pixel
6441-complete.text:
These are perfect, $N! Thanks for helping me out!

Oh, and this is for your time...
6441-complete.title: Satyr Horns

6441-progress.name: Pixel
6441-progress.text: I hope you can be quick about getting those horns, $N. I'm heading back to Ratchet soon!
6441-progress.title: Satyr Horns

6442-accept.name: Marukai
6442-accept.text:
There is evil lurking here along the coast, $r.

It is the resting place of the doomed city of Zoram, long destroyed and submerged beneath the seas.  Lost, and nearly forgotten.

Now, the naga have returned, and for what reason we do not know.  But reason matters little; we must defend the land we have worked so hard to claim as our own.

Return to me with 20 of their heads! Throw the naga back to the depths!
6442-accept.title: Naga at the Zoram Strand

6442-complete.name: Marukai
6442-complete.text: We could use more of your kind around here, $N. Thank you for your help.
6442-complete.title: Naga at the Zoram Strand

6442-progress.name: Marukai
6442-progress.text: The naga increase in numbers, $N. Please complete this task for me.
6442-progress.title: Naga at the Zoram Strand

6462-accept.name: Mitsuwa
6462-accept.text:
My kinfolk were traveling here with many sacred troll charms, but the Thistlefur furbolgs attacked and killed them before they reached Zoram'gar!  Those vile Furbolgs!

I miss my brothers and sisters who were killed, but we will meet again in the afterlife.  However, their troll charms hold great value in this world.  It is an outrage that the furbolgs have them!

$N, you must retrieve the charms!  They are in chests in Thistlefur Hold, a cave at the end of Thistlefur Village, north of Astranaar.
6462-accept.title: Troll Charm

6462-complete.name: Mitsuwa
6462-complete.text:
You found them!  Thank you!  Thank you, $N!  You do not know how great a thing you have done for me.

A troll without his charm is like an orc without his battle scars...

Worthless.
6462-complete.title: Troll Charm

6462-progress.name: Mitsuwa
6462-progress.text: Did you find the charms, $N?  Every moment the furbolgs possess those sacred items, my blood boils with rage!
6462-progress.title: Troll Charm

6482-complete.name: Yama Snowhoof
6482-complete.text:
You found my brother!  He was captured by the Thistlefurs?  That is terrible news to hear, for although many Furbolgs are noble creatures, the Thistlefurs are corrupt.

Thank you for rescuing my brother, $N.  I do not want to think of how they treated poor Ruul.  He will likely sleep long after this ordeal...
6482-complete.title: Freedom to Ruul

6503-accept.name: Kuray'bin
6503-accept.text:
We received reports that Ashenvale outrunners left Silverwing Outpost not long ago, and now sneak near our territories in the forest.  We don't want them gathering intelligence on our defenses!

Sneak through the forests south of our post here and east of the Alliance outpost of Silverwing.  Find and slay the outrunners, then return to me.
6503-accept.title: Ashenvale Outrunners

6503-complete.name: Kuray'bin
6503-complete.text:
Very good, $N.  Your hunting skills are impressive...

The loss of those outrunners helps blind the Alliance, and when they lack intelligence they are less likely to launch attacks.
6503-complete.title: Ashenvale Outrunners

6504-accept.name: Gurda Ragescar
6504-accept.text:
I just picked up this shredder from Ratchet and I was on my way back to the Warsong Lumber Camp, where I am supposed to be on duty. I was given a manual on how to operate the shredder, but on the trip back, a huge gust of wind blew it from my hands. The pages went everywhere, and all I was left with was the cover.

The pages could be just about anywhere by now, I suppose... but I don't know how to use the shredder without them! Will you find them for me?
6504-accept.title: The Lost Pages

6504-complete.name: Gurda Ragescar
6504-complete.text: Reading isn't my strong point... but now I'll be able to get back to work! Thanks, $N!
6504-complete.title: The Lost Pages

6504-progress.name: Gurda Ragescar
6504-progress.text: I hope you find the pages soon, $N! I really need to get back to work!
6504-progress.title: The Lost Pages

6561-accept.name: Unknown
6561-accept.text:
Strength has left me. Your help is needed!

Long ago this site was a great temple of Elune. But misfortune led to ruin when the corruption of an Old God seeped up from beneath the earth and tainted the sacred Moon Well.

Aku'Mai, servant of the Old God, rose from the waters.

The Twilight's Hammer cultists have allied with the naga to occupy these grounds. The cultists, led by Kelris, sacrifice innocents to Aku'Mai for power.

Slay Kelris and bring his head to Bashana in Thunder Bluff, $N, please.
6561-accept.title: Blackfathom Villainy

6561-complete.name: Bashana Runetotem
6561-complete.text:
Kelris has eluded the Argent Dawn for some time.

For some time they considered him dead or missing.

By ending his reign you have spared the lives of many innocent people, $N.

Earthmother be praised! To sacrifice another to a servant of an Old God for personal gain is beyond disgusting!

You have done a great thing this day. Kelris was a creature of evil and sought to bring the world back to a time of chaos by worshipping such creatures as the Old Gods. Thank you, $N.
6561-complete.title: Blackfathom Villainy

6561-progress.name: Bashana Runetotem
6561-progress.text:
May the Earthmother be with you, $N.

Peace between the earth and all her people should be our goal. She has a grand plan for nature, and we all have a role to play in that plan.
6561-progress.title: Blackfathom Villainy

6563-accept.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6563-accept.text:
Within the beginning tunnels of Blackfathom Deeps, large sapphire clusters can be found along the cave walls. Recently it was noted that the naga were harvesting the crystals. Until it can be discerned why, I sense we should stop the naga from succeeding. The crystals have great elemental power and if used inappropriately, could make for a powerful arcane component.

Will you help me, $N? Blackfathom Deeps can be found along Zoram Strand to the north of our outpost.
6563-accept.title: The Essence of Aku'Mai

6563-complete.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6563-complete.text:
Well done, $N. These are the crystals I spoke of. Intriguing...

I can feel the power within them. The spirits of water cling to them. Whatever the naga were going to use these for... well, let us be glad they are no longer in their hands.
6563-complete.title: The Essence of Aku'Mai

6563-progress.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6563-progress.text: How goes your search for the crystals, $N? Have you witnessed the naga harvesting them? I pray to my ancestors we find the reason they are collecting such things.
6563-progress.title: The Essence of Aku'Mai

6564-accept.name: Unknown
6564-accept.text:
Some poor handwriting is scrawled on the crumpled up note:

"Yes, tell all the priestesses to bring the crystals to me. The water elemental spirits are strong within them and they will aid our aquamancers greatly in their own summonings.

By controlling the power within the crystals, we will appease Aku'Mai. One day we will have enough power to bring Aku'Mai back to us and the world will return to its greatest era! An era of rule by the Old Gods!"
6564-accept.title: Allegiance to the Old Gods

6564-complete.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6564-complete.text:
This is interesting indeed. I am glad you have brought it to my attention.

Now we have a name for our troubles... Lorgus Jett.
6564-complete.title: Allegiance to the Old Gods

6564-progress.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6564-progress.text: Yes, $N? What is it you need? There is still much I must learn about the crystals the naga are gathering.
6564-progress.title: Allegiance to the Old Gods

6565-accept.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6565-accept.text:
This Twilight's Hammer follower cannot be allowed to complete his plan. The Twilight's Hammer do not understand the spirits of nature. They believe in the Old Gods--creatures of chaos and destruction that were long ago defeated. This Lorgus cannot be allowed to succeed. You must stop him, $N. I cannot do it myself--I am too weak.

Go into Blackfathom Deeps, find him, and kill him. Return to me here at Zoram'gar when it's done.
6565-accept.title: Allegiance to the Old Gods

6565-complete.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6565-complete.text:
Very good!! Thank you, $N. We may not have stopped the Twilight's Hammer completely, but at least you have staved off another of their plans to return the Old Gods to power.

Who knows what other plans they have manifesting, but we can rest easy for now.
6565-complete.title: Allegiance to the Old Gods

6571-accept.name: Locke Okarr
6571-accept.text:
We are in short supply of a few items at the Warsong lumber camp!

Pixel at Splintertree Post has our shipment of saw blades. It'll take a trip to Booty Bay to pick up a crate of axes from Wharfmaster Lozgil.

Our shipment of oil and rope will be more difficult. The rope was pilfered by the Thistlefur and Foulweald furbolgs, and the satyrs intercepted the delivery of the oil and are now using it for detestable rituals in Night Run, Satyrnaar, and Xavian!

Can you help me?
6571-accept.title: Warsong Supplies

6581-progress.name: Pixel
6581-progress.text:
Direct from Ratchet, the Warsong saw blades! Yep, I have them right here.

..But what sort of payment do you have for me? You can't just take them, you know! My time isn't cheap!

What I really need is a good gun to carry with me on my travels. A girl's gotta protect herself, you know? There's a gun I really like that I'm sure an engineer would have no problem making.

So, if you bring me a deadly blunderbuss, I'll give you the saw blade shipment. Do we have a deal?
6581-progress.title: Warsong Saw Blades

6621-accept.name: Karang Amakkar
6621-accept.text:
$N, another tribe of Furbolgs,  the Foulweald, live southeast of Astranaar.  They are not as many as the Thistlefur, but their ferocity poses a future threat.  With a show of force, we can remove that threat.

Take this banner, go to the Foulweald village and place it on their totem mound.  They will try to destroy the banner, but hold your ground until their chief, Murgut, appears to save face for the tribe.  Bring me the totem he carries.

Gather your allies, $N.  This is no task for a single $c.
6621-accept.title: King of the Foulweald

6621-complete.name: Karang Amakkar
6621-complete.text:
Good work, $N.  Issuing that challenge to the Foulwealds and defeating their leader sends them a strong message:

The Horde is not to be trifled with.

I don't believe that tribe will be giving us much trouble for a long time.
6621-complete.title: King of the Foulweald

6621-progress.name: Karang Amakkar
6621-progress.text: Did you defeat Chief Murgut, $N?  Did you retrieve his Foulweald Totem?
6621-progress.title: King of the Foulweald

6641-accept.name: Muglash
6641-accept.text:
Vorsha the Lasher... the fiendish hydra that roams the seas...

She has attacked our outpost, each time unprovoked, laying waste to anything that falls in her path.

But I am ready, $N. I have prepared to best the hydra and end these attacks on Zoram'gar.

The naga honor the wicked nature of this beast with a brazier that remains lit on an island just off the coast. I believe that if we put it out, Vorsha will appear in anger.

We will need help, so be sure to bring some strong allies.
6641-accept.title: Vorsha the Lasher

6681-accept.name: Unknown
6681-accept.text:
$N,

Ravenholdt has taken an interest in you, young thief. We have been watching. Your style is a bit awkward but nothing we couldn't fix.

Should you be prepared to embark on a career as a disciple of Master Ravenholdt and member of the Assassin's League, you have only to bring the Seal of Ravenholdt (attached to this letter) to Ravenholdt Manor.

Your first task is to find the manor, hidden away in the hills of Hillsbrad and demonstrate your cunning.

Regards,

Fahrad
6681-accept.title: The Manor, Ravenholdt

6681-complete.name: Fahrad
6681-complete.text:
Most excellent, young thief.

You look a bit beaten down, but no worse for the wear.

A long journey awaits you - long and rewarding. Are you prepared to finally embrace your destiny among the masters of Ravenholdt?

Speak with the guards outside. They will get you started.
6681-complete.title: The Manor, Ravenholdt

6701-complete.name: Ravenholdt Guard
6701-complete.text: Hey, nice work! Keep this up and the other rogues might stop spitting on you.
6701-complete.title: Syndicate Emblems

6701-progress.name: Ravenholdt Guard
6701-progress.text:
We have been entrenched in a battle with the Syndicate for years. What they lack in skill they make up for in numbers. It's impossible to kill them off fast enough to have any noticeable impact on their population!

We've found that the best way to deal with their size is to pilfer their emblems. Once an emblem is stolen the shamed member is 'dealt' with internally.

Pick their pockets clean and turn the emblems in to me or one of the other guards.

Start at Durnholde, south of here.
6701-progress.title: Syndicate Emblems

6921-accept.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6921-accept.text:
The Twilight's Hammer has moved into the Moonshrine Ruins of Blackfathom Deeps.  Their presence can only serve to coerce the elements into working against us.  If left unchecked, this region will be theirs for good.

$N, go into Blackfathom and find the ruin's fathom stone; it should be somewhere close in the water.  In it is a fathom core - a device that when properly read it will relate a history of all elemental activity.  If I have it, I and the Earthen Ring can maybe do something to stop them!
6921-accept.title: Amongst the Ruins

6921-complete.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6921-complete.text:
This is exactly what I need!  A fathom core is an incredible well of information that we will be able to draw much good from.  Whatever the Twilight's Hammer is up to in there - and believe me when I say it is no good - my comrades and I will now uncover.

You've done well here today; the Earthen Ring looks upon you warmly for assisting us.  You've also helped the Horde as a whole, and for that you should be proud.
6921-complete.title: Amongst the Ruins

6921-progress.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6921-progress.text: Have you been successful in locating the fathom core?  Without it we'll have no idea what the Twilight's Hammer is exactly up to down there.
6921-progress.title: Amongst the Ruins

6922-accept.name: Unknown
6922-accept.text:
The defeated water elemental has left behind a strange water globe.  You surmise that the object somehow fed the beast energy.  Inside the globe, a putrid-looking form of water sloshes about.  The globe itself seems impervious to any sort of physical force.

If anyone can make any sense of this item, it would be Je'neu Sancrea of the Earthen Ring.  He is located at the Horde's Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale.
6922-accept.title: Baron Aquanis

6922-complete.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6922-complete.text:
This... this is quite the find, $N.

You acquired this from Baron Aquanis in Blackfathom, you say?  Baron Aquanis has long been thought of as a corrupted elemental power; this globe will prove what exactly had corrupted him.  While it would be no surprise if it turned out to be the Twilight's Hammer, our studies will also show how they did it as well.

You did well in bringing this to me.  Please - take this, along with the Earthen Ring's warmest regards.
6922-complete.title: Baron Aquanis

6922-progress.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6922-progress.text: Ah, hello again $N.  I was just reading the waves the sea, much like I always do.  What brings you to the outpost?
6922-progress.title: Baron Aquanis

95663-accept.name: Zaruk
95663-accept.text:
The Dragonmaw are a formidable clan.

They're known for binding magic strong enough to make dragons serve, and rumor claims they're preparing some display of it in the Wetlands. Whether truth or bluster, the Deathstalkers can't act on half-formed whispers. Titanic winds carried only that much to me.

A deathstalker agent needs a hand in the hills above the Dragonmaw encampment. Meet her there. She'll reveal the next steps.
95663-accept.title: Dragonmaw Rumors

95663-complete.name: Deathstalker Agent
95663-complete.text: Arrival of the courageous few? Mind your voice.
95663-complete.title: Dragonmaw Rumors

95664-accept.name: Unknown
95664-accept.text: This unusual composite shard scatters light like a living prism. Its nature is uncertain, but its power feels ancient. The most knowledgeable minds for artifacts of this bygone age must reside on the Elder rise in Thunder Bluff.
95664-accept.title: Elder Knowledge

95682-accept.name: Deathstalker Agent
95682-accept.text:
Dragonmaw. <She lets out a dry, amused scoff.>

The remnants of the dragon-wrangling clan think they've found something that could lead to them rising to their former power. In the eyes of whom... their false warchief?

Clear out their ragtag clan within the Excavation Sites so our Deathstalkers can move in undetected.

If the Dragonmaw carry anything of note upon them, return it to me--this information must stay between us and our royal command.
95682-accept.title: Open the Maw

95682-complete.name: Deathstalker Agent
95682-complete.text:
Don't mind me snatching that right out of your hands.

I recognized that orcish scrawl. So they're hoping to appease Rend? A fruitless and wasted effort. 

No matter, this is highly valuable knowledge for the dark lady to consider.

Here, I won't be taking any of this with me--and don't talk about the mission, grunt.
95682-complete.title: Open the Maw

95682-progress.name: Deathstalker Agent
95682-progress.text: We're here to get the important job done. If you can help, prove it.
95682-progress.title: Open the Maw

95697-accept.name: Holy
95697-accept.text:
Zamja tells me we need more homestyle cooking.
If we start selling raptor, she thinks it'll draw in customers who don't usually visit Borstan's Firepit.

Her idea is not so bad. But I want something that rises above the smells of our birth villages. We're in Orgrimmar! Borstan should serve a grand take on their familiar favorites.

A hunter recently came back from the Wetlands with a giant talon from the thicket raptors in the Excavation Sites.

Up for a job?
95697-accept.title: Changing Tastes

95883-accept.name: Unknown
95883-accept.text:
<The preparations for a hastily-assembled ritual are gathered unceremoniously on the altar. According to the scrap of note, everything has been gathered. All that's missing are the offering of blood and the Tortured Soul.

The $r around you look tortured enough. They may have what you seek.>
95883-accept.title: The Tortured Soul

95883-complete.name: Unknown
95883-complete.text:
<The tortured soul lets out a foul energy in the presence of the offering stone.

It appears you are closer to fulfilling the ritual.>
95883-complete.title: The Tortured Soul

95884-accept.name: Unknown
95884-accept.text:
<The scrap of note is mostly illegible. What is still readable, however, are notes about preparations for an offering.

An offering stone is mentioned, as well as a ritual.

Perhaps you can find this offering stone nearby.>
95884-accept.title: The Offering Stone

95884-complete.name: Unknown
95884-complete.text:
<Strange implements and items litter the rough surface of the stone.

This is surely the offering stone that is mentioned in the note.>
95884-complete.title: The Offering Stone

95885-accept.name: Unknown
95885-accept.text:
<All that's left now is the offering of blood.

The note scrap mentioned a 'willing sacrifice.'

An intense sense of dread washes over you.>
95885-accept.title: The Offering of Blood

95885-complete.name: Unknown
95885-complete.text:
<The offering stone is inert now. It appears your ritual drained it of power. To what end, you do not know, but it is over now.

The rough stone cracks and crumbles, now devoid of purpose.

Something glitters from within the remnants...>
95885-complete.title: The Offering of Blood

95981-complete.name: Shadow Priest Allister
95981-complete.text:
Ever since the barrier went down around Dalaran, the Kirin Tor have maintained a death grip on the roads. They're paranoid about something, that much is certain.

For now, however, the why is irrelevant.
95981-complete.title: Watching the Roads

96779-accept.name: Myrokos Silentform
96779-accept.text:
Sometimes, $r, a single cut in the right place will drop a foe dead. The same is often true of organizations.

Our agents have identified a key target among the ranks of the Syndicate: a man by the name of Lord Tomas.

He plays an instrumental role in the functions of Durnholde Keep, in Hillsbrad Foothills. If you wish to be of service to Ravenholdt, go to Durnholde and eliminate him. The quicker, and quieter, the better.
96779-accept.title: Syndicate Sabotage

96781-accept.name: Myrokos Silentform
96781-accept.text:
We have noticed a Syndicate scouting party prowling around the ruins of Alterac, led by a man named Barton.

They're clearly searching for something, but I cannot know what without reading his scouting reports.

I ask that you pickpocket the report from him, rather than killing him outright. Barton's death will tip off the Syndicate that we're on to them, and they will certainly take counter-measures to cover their tracks.

If you hope to find him, he is most likely among the Syndicate at Strahnbrad.
96781-accept.title: What's the Big Idea?

96783-accept.name: Myrokos Silentform
96783-accept.text:
Stromgarde Keep is one of the Syndicate's largest strongholds. Many of the organization's most important dealings take place behind its walls.

I have received word of a certain trade taking place between members of the Syndicate somewhere in Arathi Highlands, and I'm certain the details of this trade can be found somewhere in Stromgarde.

To infiltrate the keep without arousing suspicion, you'll need a disguise. See if you can find one among the Syndicate outside the keep, at Northfold Manor.
96783-accept.title: A Way In

96986-accept.name: Melisara
96986-accept.text:
Within the underbelly of the mage city to the north is a traitor to our kind. A necromancer of disturbing talent. He raises an army of undeath right under the Kirin Tor's nose.

I care not for the fate of the mage city, $N, but this grave knight spits in the face of everything we Forsaken stand for. Put an end to him. Show him no one is beyond the reach of the Dark Lady.
96986-accept.title: The Grave Knight

97583-accept.name: Excitable Slime
97583-accept.text:
<The little slime seems delighted and is attempting to mirror your motions as you dance. It begins to look weary though.

The little slime hovers over a bit of sludge and absorbs it, looking slightly rejuvenated.

It seems all of this dancing has tuckered it out. Perhaps someone in the Undercity canals sells more of this nutritious sludge?>
97583-accept.title: WRIGGLE.

97583-complete.name: Excitable Slime
97583-complete.text: <The slime shudders with newfound energy. It seems to want to follow you, now that it has associated you with food.>
97583-complete.title: WRIGGLE.

97583-progress.name: Excitable Slime
97583-progress.text: <The slime seems to regard you with interest.>
97583-progress.title: WRIGGLE.

98094-accept.name: High Executor Darthalia
98094-accept.text:
Now that we can trust you to deliver critical information to our forward spies, there's an extra task for you.

Bring this to Deathstalker Masoj almost directly south of us. He'll have more for you to do once you get there and hand this to him. He is posted on elevated terrain north of the rotten vineyard they call Nethander Stead.

Our plan to take control of these lands continues steadily.
98094-accept.title: Scout Support

99-accept.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
99-accept.text:
As my understanding of Arugal's magic grows so does my disdain for the hapless fool.  I am close to completing my research on his so called remedy.

My knowledge will be complete when I learn what enchantment is causing the strange behavior going on in Pyrewood Village.  By day, the peasants appear to be Human.  But when the sun goes down the townsfolk turn into Moonrage Worgen.

I need to draw energy from the enchanted shackles Arugal cast on them.  Bring to me six enchanted Pyrewood Shackles, $N.
99-accept.title: Arugal's Folly
